title: Frosted wallet card animations
summary: A dark wallet card you can freeze under scrapeable frost, reveal, and shatter into grain on delete.
brief: Make a dark phone wallet in the browser whose graphite card freezes under needle-like frost that the pointer can scrape away, reveals its number on demand, and crumbles into drifting grain when deleted before the next card slides in.

prompts.text: Build a dark wallet card demo as one self-contained web page (HTML, CSS and JavaScript, Canvas allowed). Centre a phone-width panel (about 440px wide) on a near-black page with no title or other text outside it: a small "Cards" header with page dots, a large brushed-graphite credit card filling the panel width with a soft diagonal metallic sheen, a silver chip, large white digits in a clean rounded sans-serif "•••• •••• •••• 4242", a cardholder name and expiry, a line "Visa ending in 4242", three rounded dark pills (Freeze, Details, Delete) and a wide white "Add a card" button. Make the interactions feel physical. Freeze grows frost in from the edges over about a second until the card is clearly frozen at a glance: a texture of countless fine grey-white ice needles like frost fur, densest and brightest along all four edges and fading to a milky grey translucent haze in the middle where the digits still show through blurred; the frost stays inside the card's rounded shape, with no flat solid white areas or frame; add a snowflake badge and a muted "Frozen" label. While frozen, moving or dragging the pointer over the card erases the frost where it passes, leaving a wide dark clear path of bare card that stays, with small white ice flakes falling from the pointer; no text selection. Unfreeze melts the frost away. Details reveals the full number and a CVV with a smooth digit change, and the pill becomes Hide. Delete turns the pill coral red "Confirm"; a second click disintegrates the card into thousands of tiny grains sampled from its pixels, dissolving from left to right over about 1.2 seconds while the undissolved part stays solid, each grain drifting right and fading, as a lighter silver card slides in behind it. Use your own card brand name and no logos. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in the browser when done, check that it works, and ask before installing or loading anything.

made.alt: A dark wallet with a graphite card. Freeze grows needle frost in from the edges; the cursor scrapes a dark path through it as ice flakes fall. Unfreeze melts it, Delete turns red and the card crumbles into grain from left to right as a silver card appears.
made.caption: The wallet card built with Hey Atu freezes, gets scraped clear, thaws and crumbles into grain.
